   884→// formatSessionInfo formats session information for display.
   885→func formatSessionInfo(session *strategy.Session, sourceRef string, checkpoints []checkpointDetail) string {
   886→	var sb strings.Builder
   887→
   888→	// Session header
   889→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", session.ID)
   890→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Strategy: %s\n", session.Strategy)
   891→
   892→	if !session.StartTime.IsZero() {
   893→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Started: %s\n", session.StartTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   894→	}
   895→
   896→	if sourceRef != "" {
   897→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Source Ref: %s\n", sourceRef)
   898→	}
   899→
   900→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoints: %d\n", len(checkpoints))
   901→
   902→	// Checkpoint details
   903→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   904→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   905→
   906→		// Checkpoint header
   907→		taskMarker := ""
   908→		if cp.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   909→			taskMarker = " [Task]"
   910→		}
   911→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "─── Checkpoint %d [%s] %s%s ───\n",
   912→			cp.Index, cp.ShortID, cp.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04"), taskMarker)
   913→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   914→
   915→		// Display all interactions in this checkpoint
   916→		for i, inter := range cp.Interactions {
   917→			// For multiple interactions, add a sub-header
   918→			if len(cp.Interactions) > 1 {
   919→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "### Interaction %d\n\n", i+1)

  1083→type checkpointGroup struct {

  1098→// groupByCheckpointID groups rewind points by their checkpoint ID.
  1099→// Returns groups sorted by latest commit timestamp (most recent first).
  1100→func groupByCheckpointID(points []strategy.RewindPoint) []checkpointGroup {
  1101→	if len(points) == 0 {
  1102→		return nil
  1103→	}
  1104→
  1105→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> group
  1106→	groupMap := make(map[string]*checkpointGroup)
  1107→	var order []string // Track insertion order for stable iteration
  1108→
  1109→	for _, point := range points {
  1110→		// Determine the checkpoint ID to use
  1111→		cpID := point.CheckpointID.String()
  1112→		if cpID == "" {
  1113→			// Temporary checkpoints use git commit hash with ~ prefix
  1114→			// Use 11 chars so total length with ~ is still 12
  1115→			cpID = point.ID
  1116→			if len(cpID) > checkpointIDDisplayLength-1 {
  1117→				cpID = cpID[:checkpointIDDisplayLength-1]
  1118→			}
  1119→			cpID = "~" + cpID
  1120→		}
  1121→
  1122→		group, exists := groupMap[cpID]
  1123→		if !exists {
  1124→			group = &checkpointGroup{
  1125→				checkpointID: cpID,
  1126→				prompt:       point.SessionPrompt,
  1127→				isTemporary:  !point.IsLogsOnly,
  1128→				isTask:       point.IsTaskCheckpoint,
  1129→			}
  1130→			groupMap[cpID] = group
  1131→			order = append(order, cpID)
  1132→		}
  1133→
  1134→		// Short git SHA (7 chars)
  1135→		gitSHA := point.ID
  1136→		if len(gitSHA) > 7 {
  1137→			gitSHA = gitSHA[:7]
  1138→		}
  1139→
  1140→		group.commits = append(group.commits, commitEntry{
  1141→			date:    point.Date,
  1142→			gitSHA:  gitSHA,
  1143→			message: point.Message,
  1144→		})
  1145→
  1146→		// Update flags - if any commit is temporary, the group is temporary
  1147→		if !point.IsLogsOnly {
  1148→			group.isTemporary = true
  1149→		}
  1150→	}
  1151→
  1152→	// Sort commits within each group by date (most recent first)
  1153→	for _, group := range groupMap {
  1154→		sort.Slice(group.commits, func(i, j int) bool {
  1155→			return group.commits[i].date.After(group.commits[j].date)
  1156→		})
  1157→	}
  1158→
  1159→	// Build result slice in order, then sort by latest commit
  1160→	result := make([]checkpointGroup, 0, len(order))
  1161→	for _, cpID := range order {
  1162→		result = append(result, *groupMap[cpID])
  1163→	}
  1164→
  1165→	// Sort groups by latest commit timestamp (most recent first)
  1166→	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
  1167→		// Each group's commits are already sorted, so first commit is latest
  1168→		if len(result[i].commits) == 0 {
  1169→			return false
  1170→		}
  1171→		if len(result[j].commits) == 0 {
  1172→			return true
  1173→		}
  1174→		return result[i].commits[0].date.After(result[j].commits[0].date)
  1175→	})
  1176→
  1177→	return result
  1178→}

  1187→

  1190→	if group.isTask {

  1229→//
  1230→// This filters out periodic transcript saves that don't change code.
  1231→func hasCodeChanges(commit *object.Commit) bool {
  1232→	// First commit on shadow branch captures working copy state - always meaningful
  1233→	if commit.NumParents() == 0 {
  1234→		return true
  1235→	}
  1236→
  1237→	parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1238→	if err != nil {

  1241→
  1242→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()

  1246→
  1247→	parentTree, err := parent.Tree()
  1248→	if err != nil {

  1250→	}
  1251→
  1252→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1253→	if err != nil {
  1254→		return true
  1255→	}
  1256→
  1257→	// Check if any non-metadata file was changed
  1258→	for _, change := range changes {
  1259→		name := change.To.Name
  1260→		if name == "" {
  1261→			name = change.From.Name
  1262→		}
  1263→		// Skip .entire/ metadata files
  1264→		if !strings.HasPrefix(name, ".entire/") {
  1265→			return true
  1266→		}
  1267→	}
  1268→
  1269→	return false
  1270→}

  1276→	}
  1277→	if maxLen <= 3 {

- Code changes ARE being recorded in the shadow branch commits
